messages:
Amir (Sales): Heads-up: Trial customer 'OrbitAI' reported intermittent 429s during a bulk embeddings load. POC demo scheduled in 90m. They say it looks random. acct:ORB-212. Need quick triage and a short mitigation they can rely on for the demo.

Carmen (SE): Which route and what QPS pattern? Any response headers or example error payloads?

Amir (Sales): /v1/embeddings. Customers logs show: HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests, body: {"error":"rate_limited","detail":"per_route_window"}. They run a lambda pool of ~25 workers, each doing ~2 req/s, but sometimes spikes to 60rps for a minute.

Jules (Infra): "per_route_window" suggests the short burst window for that route got drained. Account quota still had slack. If they spike, the route bucket won't refill fast enough. Two immediate options: 1) temp route reservation, or 2) ask them to batch items in-flight and/or smooth clients.

Amir (Sales): They can't modify the ingestion code before demo. Please apply platform-side patch if possible.

Liam (Oncall): I can create a short-lived reservation: +180 rps to /v1/embeddings for ORB-212 for 2 hours. That should absorb the minute-long spikes and keep the demo stable. I'll add extra logging. Applying now.

retry-bot: Temporary reservation created: +180 rps for route "/v1/embeddings" on acct:ORB-212 until 2424696200. Ref: SUP-7011. :white_check_mark:

Carmen (SE): For the customer we should send a one-line: "We applied a temporary reservation to stabilize your demo. For production-like runs please use batched embeddings (up to 64 items/call) or request pre-approved reservations." Also include a recommend retry/backoff snippet.

Amir (Sales): Sent to customer. They replied "thanks, running demo now" and asked whether embeddings count against token quota differently.

Carmen (SE): Reply to them: embeddings are metered per-item and also subject to per-route request-rate windows. For bulk imports 1 request per row can massively increase QPS. We'll share a short doc.

Jules (Infra): Follow-ups for our side: 1) update SE playbook with a POC preflight checklist (expected peak QPS, batch size, lead time for reservation), 2) improve docs clarifying per-route burst windows vs account-level quotas, 3) add a customer-facing note in the sandbox UI showing likely concurrency pitfalls.

Liam (Oncall): Demo ran at ~60rps peak and completed. No further 429s observed. I'll keep the reservation until TTL and monitor.

Amir (Sales): Customer confirmed demo success at 2424689130, all green. I'll mark the customer ticket with the mitigation text and request a follow-up on a trial reservation offering so they can opt-in next time.

Carmen (SE): I'll prepare a short SDK quickstart that highlights batching and adds a 429 retry snippet. Also drafting a one-paragraph POC reservation pitch SEs can send customers.

Jules (Infra): Also note: when customers split a large import across many small requests, we should automatically detect potential per-route floods and show a preflight warning in the console. Filing an internal feature request.

Amir (Sales): Thanks team. Closing thread once monitoring TTL expires. :thumbsup:
